user_story: As a user, I want to be prevented from registering with an already-used email so that duplicate accounts are avoided.

positive.title: Register with a new email
steps: Enter a valid email that is not registered.
positive.expected_result: User registration is successful, and an account is created with the new email.

negative.title: Register with an already-used email
steps: Enter an email that is already registered.
negative.expected_result: The registration process is halted, and an error message is displayed stating that the email is already in use.

edge.title: Register with an email in different case format
steps: Enter the same email as an existing account but with different casing (e.g., test@example.com vs. TEST@example.com).
edge.expected_result: The registration process is halted, and an error message is displayed stating that the email is already in use, considering email addresses as case-insensitive.
